summary: Backend enforcement complete and tested (84/84 tests pass). Three frontend gaps remain: ProjectSettingsModal missing cost_limit_usd input, no cost indicator on design screen, no budget-pause status label.

unmet_requirements.description: ProjectSettingsModal.tsx has no cost_limit_usd number input. Users cannot configure budget limits via UI — must use API directly.
unmet_requirements.workaround: Set budget via API: PUT /api/autopilot/projects/{project_id} with {"cost_limit_usd": 100.00}

unmet_requirements.requirement: UI — Cost Display on Autopilot Design Screen
unmet_requirements.description: No '$current / $limit' indicator on DesignQueuePanel.tsx or PipelineStatusCard.tsx. Users must check API to see budget status.
No frontend component checks paused_by === 'budget' to display 'Paused: budget limit reached'. Users cannot distinguish budget-paused from user-paused workflows.
unmet_requirements.workaround: Check workflow.paused_by field via API to determine pause reason

positive_deviations: _run_one_feature() updates feature status to 'paused' with reason 'Budget limit reached' for better visibility
User pause clears stale budget status_reason to prevent confusing messages
Budget guard logging includes exact cost amounts for easier debugging
edge_cases_verified: Concurrent cost entries don't cause double-pause (idempotent)
Spend lands at-or-slightly-over limit (enforcement stops next call)
Limit raised while budget-paused clears pause correctly
Phase 0 workflows included in budget pause
Play button does NOT resume budget-paused projects
No limit set (cost_limit_usd=None) — guard is no-op
Cost equals exact limit — blocks correctly (>= comparison)
recommendations: Add cost indicator to DesignQueuePanel.tsx or PipelineStatusCard.tsx (G-2)
Add 'Paused: budget limit reached' badge for budget-paused workflows (G-3)
Consider per-design budget limits as future enhancement
conditions_for_full_pass: G-1: Add cost_limit_usd input to ProjectSettingsModal.tsx
G-2: Add '$current / $limit' cost indicator to design screen
G-3: Add 'Paused: budget limit reached' label for budget-paused workflows
